themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints exploded to 130 THIS WEEK—a 393% spike versus the 8-week average of 26.4 weekly complaints (z-score: 10.67)—suggesting a sudden deterioration in road quality across Sunnyside/Woodside that warrants immediate investigation into what triggered this acute failure.
evidence: 130 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 26.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (393% increase)
Z-score of 10.67 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Street Sweeping Complaints also spiked: 6 complaints last week vs. 0.2 average (2300% increase, z-score: 8.69)
Street Sign - Dangling complaints up 205% two weeks ago (8 complaints vs. 2.6 average, z-score: 6.27)
reporting_angles: Investigate what caused the sudden deterioration: weather event, deferred maintenance cycle, or service cuts?
Interview residents and local business owners about how street conditions are affecting daily life and commerce
Examine DOT resource allocation and street maintenance schedules for CD 402 vs. other districts

themes_detail.label: Rodent Infestation Surge
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints surged to 9 THIS WEEK—a 213% spike from the 8-week baseline of 2.9 weekly complaints (z-score: 10.22)—indicating a potential pest crisis coinciding with elevated Missed Collection (15 complaints vs. 2.5 average) and Unsanitary Condition complaints that may be creating breeding grounds.
evidence: 9 rodent complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (213% increase, z-score: 10.22)
Missed Collection complaints at 15 THIS WEEK vs. 2.5 average (500% spike, z-score: 6.45)—suggesting garbage accumulation fueling pest activity
Unsanitary Condition is 258 total complaints over 90 days but appears concentrated in recent period based on spike patterns
reporting_angles: Track whether missed garbage collections are directly linked to rodent infestation zones—obtain DSNY pickup records
Interview residents in affected blocks; map rodent complaints to identify geographic hotspot
Examine whether service staffing or operational changes at DSNY are causing collection failures

themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints hit 4 LAST WEEK, a staggering 3100% spike from near-zero baseline (0.1 average, z-score: 11.72)—the highest z-score anomaly in the dataset—suggesting organized graffiti, advertising, or posting activity that warrants enforcement investigation.
evidence: 4 Illegal Posting complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (3100% increase)
Z-score of 11.72 is the single highest anomaly in entire dataset, indicating extreme statistical rarity
Likely related to street infrastructure decline: degraded surfaces may be more attractive to illegal posters
reporting_angles: Identify whether postings are gang-related, political, commercial advertising, or other category—photograph locations
Interview NYPD and Parks Enforcement about whether they've noticed uptick in specific neighborhoods within CD 402
Check if timing correlates with any known gang activity, election cycle, or commercial campaign

themes_detail.label: Building Violation Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use violations spiked to 10 complaints THIS WEEK—a 300% increase from the 2.5 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.67)—coupled with 551 DOB permits filed in past 90 days (378 alterations), suggesting potential code enforcement gaps or illegal occupancy conversions amid heavy construction activity.
evidence: 10 Building/Use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.5 weekly average (300% spike, z-score: 5.67)
551 total DOB permits filed in past 90 days, with 378 alterations—indicating active construction ecosystem
378 alteration permits could mask illegal conversions or unpermitted uses if enforcement lags
reporting_angles: Obtain sample of Building/Use complaint details: are violations concentrated in specific blocks or building types?
Interview DOB inspectors about enforcement capacity and timeline for violations in CD 402
Investigate whether alteration permits are being properly inspected post-completion; check Alteration CO (42) vs. Alteration (378) ratio

themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Missed Collection complaints hit 15 THIS WEEK—a 500% spike from the 2.5 weekly average (z-score: 6.45)—compounding rodent infestation risks and street sanitation, indicating potential systemic failure in DSNY service delivery across the district.
evidence: 15 Missed Collection complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.5 weekly average (500% increase, z-score: 6.45)
Timing overlaps with rodent spike (9 complaints THIS WEEK) and street sweeping complaints (6 last week)—suggests interconnected sanitation breakdown
No recent council constituent cases data, but pattern indicates escalating resident frustration
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY sanitation workers about staffing levels, truck availability, and route changes in CD 402
Map missed collection complaints geographically to identify whether failure is district-wide or concentrated in specific zones
Obtain DSNY performance data for Sunnyside/Woodside vs. citywide baseline; investigate whether this district receives proportional resources
